program.name: Tabata Thirty
program.subject: Busy week
program.blurb: Strength supersets, then two Tabatas, in a little over half an hour.
program.about: Strength and sweat in one go. Two supersets of a lower and an upper lift come first, then two Tabatas, twenty seconds hard and ten seconds rest, eight times each. Two days alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III slows the lowering to three seconds.
program.split: Supersets and two Tabatas, A / B
